body:

No uncommitted changes remained (working tree was clean), and the branch `bb/relay-224-module-contract-04-12-formalize-the-fo-thr_cwsii7ns4z` has been pushed to origin successfully.

## Summary

This implements issue #224 by formalizing the existing forward-only structural migration runner (`runMigrations` in `backend/packages/data/src/db/migrate.ts`, which already satisfied the ordering/once-only/rollback-and-stop requirements) as delivered tooling:

- Added `backend/packages/data/src/db/runMigrationsCli.ts`, a small entrypoint that reads `DATABASE_URL` and applies the migrations directory via the existing `createPool`/`runMigrations`.
- Added a `migrate` script to `backend/package.json` that builds `@semprec/data` and runs the compiled CLI; updated `@semprec/data`'s build step to copy `src/db/migrations/*.sql` into `dist` so the compiled CLI can find them.
- Verified end-to-end against a real ephemeral Postgres instance: all 10 existing migrations applied, recorded in `schema_migrations`, and a second run was a true no-op.
- Added `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/migrate.test.ts` with integration coverage against a scratch schema: ascending-order + once-only application (including no-op re-run), and rollback-and-stop on a failing file (no partial effect, no later file applied, successful retry on the next run).
- Full workspace build (`pnpm -r run build`) and full test suite (25 files, 315 tests) pass.
